subject: Next steps and 30-min product showcase — proposed windows
body:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Aiden Ford <aiden.ford@orbitx.com>
Cc: Rekha Shah <rekha@orbitx.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps and 30-min product showcase — proposed windows

Hi Aiden / Rekha,

Thanks again for the discovery call today — great to learn more about OrbitX's ingestion pipeline constraints and the two key workloads you flagged (interactive search and nightly indexing). Quick recap / alignment before we lock next steps: 

- Top priorities you mentioned: 95th percentile latency < 250ms for interactive API calls; consistent nightly throughput for embedding generation.
- Success criteria for an initial pilot: end-to-end demo of a production-like request, a baseline cost estimate for steady-state, and a short ops checklist for integration.
- Internal stakeholders to invite: your CTO (ops/infra), a product owner (prioritization), and the engineer who owns the ingestion pipeline.

To keep momentum, could we book a 30-minute product showcase (high-level demo + Q&A + infra checklist) with your team? I can join with our solutions engineer to cover runtime behavior and simple integration patterns. Here are three time windows (all PT):

Option A: Mon 24 May — 10:00–10:30 PT
Option B: Tue 25 May — 14:00–14:30 PT
Option C: Wed 26 May — 09:00–09:30 PT

If none of those work, please propose two alternatives next week. Also let me know which internal attendees you want to include (CTO? engineering owner?). I'm attaching the discovery notes and a short MVP success criteria spreadsheet for your review.

Next steps I propose after the showcase: 1) technical deep-dive (40–60m) if the team wants to validate latency/cost knobs; 2) mutual action plan draft with timeline.

Thanks — I can send calendar invites once you confirm a window and attendee list.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Discovery-notes.pdf (summary), MVP-success-criteria.xlsx (stub)

-----Original Message-----
From: Aiden Ford <aiden.ford@orbitx.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Rekha Shah <rekha@orbitx.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 08:17:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps and 30-min product showcase — proposed windows

Chloe, thanks for the recap — that mirrors what we captured internally. Option C (Wed 26 May 09:00 PT) is tight because our CTO is traveling, but Option B (Tue 25 May 14:00 PT) looks promising.

Quick ask: can we include our infra lead (Samir Patel, samir.p@orbitx.com) and our product lead (Rekha — cc'd)? Also, do you have any short pre-read on expected network egress patterns when using prefix caching? That'll help our infra team prioritize the slot.

—Aiden
Director of Product, OrbitX

On Fri, May 21, 2026 at 08:55 AM PDT, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com> wrote:

> Thanks Aiden — great.
>
> Tue 25 May 14:00–14:30 PT works for us. I'll invite our solutions engineer (Marissa Cole) to handle the operational/infra portion.
>
> For pre-read: attaching a one-pager on prefix/KV caching behavior and expected egress patterns under common batching profiles — see the "Discovery-notes.pdf" (page 2) and the separate outline link in the header. If Samir or Rekha want anything more technical ahead of the meeting, Marissa can loop in our runtime engineer.
>
> Could you confirm Samir's calendar address so I can add him to the invite? Also confirm if Rekha will join as product lead.
>
> I'll draft a short agenda: 1) 10m product walkthrough (Chloe) 2) 12m infra deep-dive (Marissa) 3) 8m Q&A / next steps.
>
> Sending a calendar hold now; I'll update when you confirm attendees.
>
> Cheers,
> Chloe
